'''Comet''' was a pet [[kima]] belonging to an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Meatlumps]], a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellia-based]] gang of technology-hating thugs and criminals, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:MC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Comet was adopted by a spacer who killed its previous master while investigating the Meatlumps for ''[[Corellia Times]]'' [[Journalist/Legends|reporters]].<ref name="SWG:MtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Muddle the Meatlumps|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Comet appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Comet was added to the game with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
